info.description:
The course is primarily developed around the individual student’s undergraduate thesis project on a specific topic of interest in the field of English language (English language teaching or business English). The project includes search for, studies and summary of relevant literature, practical work of data collection and analysis, and oral and written presentation.

The undergraduate thesis project is mastered under individual supervision. The supervision includes how to perform a scientific study and how to scientifically organize research results into written and oral forms.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Identify a research problem and develop research questions to conduct an independent study
Identify, summarise and critically evaluate literature and write a literature review of the relevant field.
Develop research instruments to collect and analyse data to enable the research questions to be answered.
Demonstrate appropriate referencing and develop aspects of written and oral presentation skills.
